name: Forte Metals
verdict: Forte Metals saw zero paid activity across Meta and Google Ads in the last 28 days, making Google Business Profile the sole source of engagement with 85 total actions (44 directions, 36 web clicks, 5 calls). The biggest concern is GBP actions dropping 100% in the last 7 days versus the prior 7 days, likely signaling a listing issue, suspension, or a sudden drop in local search visibility that needs immediate investigation.

performance.verdict: GBP went dark Aug 29; organic is the only channel and it's dead.

findings.text: GBP actions dropped 100% in the last 7d — last recorded action was Aug 28 (12 actions); zero for 12 consecutive days. Listing issue or suspension probable.
Search clicks collapsed: 3-day signal (Sep 6–8) = 0 clicks vs prior 3 days (Sep 3–5) = 4 clicks — 100% drop, inside a broader 63% 7d decline.
OVERDUE — 342 stub accounts (blocker, due Aug 31) unreconciled; Sales-i sync keys on Customer ID, so these accounts receive zero pipeline data until fixed.
OVERDUE — AGS + Forte contact pull for outreach (blocker, due Aug 31) not completed; cold email/calling pipeline cannot launch without this list.
OVERDUE — Web/SEO root cause named + fix submitted (blocker, due Aug 31) outstanding; likely connected to GBP dark signal starting Aug 29.

suggestions.text: Audit GBP listing immediately — check suspension status, ownership, and local ranking drop that caused 12 days of zero actions.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions went to zero on Aug 29 and have not recovered — 12 consecutive zero-action days as of Sep 8, down from 12 actions on Aug 28. Check the listing for suspension, ownership conflicts, or a category/address change that triggered a Google review. Success is confirmed when daily GBP actions return to the Aug 12–28 baseline of 3–12/day. Complete audit and remediation by Sep 12.
